feature.label: Eclipse-mieux Extras
feature.description: Eclipse-mieux's own additions on top of stock Eclipse Platform: the Mieux Lilac workbench theme. (The native vim mode that used to live here was pulled out -- see git history/vim/org.eclipse.mieux.vim -- in favor of vendoring Vrapper instead.) Included directly in org.eclipse.sdk.ide's product definition (see products/eclipse-sdk/sdk.product in the aggregator, patched in by scripts/build.sh) since that product is feature-based (type="features") and ignores bare <plugin> entries.
